Inviting, Beautiful and Stunning are just a few words to describe this beautiful Beach House designed with lots of planning and lots of love. Located on the beachside of Hwy 30-A only 7/10 of a mile from the heart of Seaside. This newly constructed Home offers a breathtaking 180 degree view of the Gulf of Mexico with the Beach access only 12 steps from your private heated pool.

This luxurious Beach House offers all of the conveniences of Home and is only steps from the white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Designed and built with entertaining in mind, this three story, 3,750 sq. ft. home has a total of 4 bedrooms plus a bunk room for the kids, and 5 full and 2 half baths. There are 2 spacious Master Suites; each with shower, jacuzzi tub and spectacular views. A private elevator services all floors for groceries, luggage and guests with special needs. Added luxuries include wifi, wall safes in both Master suites, central vacuum and garage. This is an excellent setting for a small company function or a gathering of family and friends.

The top floor has exquisite views from the state-of-the-art kitchen with vaulted ceiling. Marble countertop, Sub Zero Refrigerator, Ice machine,stainless appliances and a 4 x 8 ft teak island with gas cooktop make cooking a breeze. Wide plank hardwood floors in the kitchen are carried throughout the living room where you can relax by the gas fireplace with flat screen TV above the mantle and surround sound throughout. Large covered decks overlook the gulf and pool. The Master Suite has a King bed, double vanity, walk-in closet, jacuzzi tub and steam shower with windows looking through the bedroom to the Gulf. A private walkout balcony opens above the pool for breathtaking views.

The 2nd floor also has wide plank hardwoods throughout. A 2nd Master Suite mirrors the 3rd floor with King bed, jacuzzi tub, shower and walk-out balcony. The additional 2 Guest rooms each have King beds with private baths and walk-in closet. A large laundry room with washer, dryer and utility sink is located between the rooms for optimum convenience.

The kids will love the ground floor! Built-in bunk beds with plenty of storage space, closet and full bath can accommodate 5 children. A living area with T.V., DVD and stereo just steps from the pool makes this area ideal for entertaining the kids. Outside you can relax by the private, heated pool and hot tub with a large covered patio. An added convenience is an outdoor shower with changing room and pool bath. An outdoor grill area with under counter refrigerator and gas grill will make entertaining easy and fun.

This house was designed to ensure a special experience at one of the most beautiful beaches in the country!

reviews.text:
Extremely spacious and comfortable property. Immaculately clean on arrival and well provisioned. Grandkids loved the bunks downstairs and, of course, the pool. The sugar white beach was just steps away; an easy walk even for those with knee challenges. We have vacationed on 30A for years, most often at Seaside, but My Wifes a Beach is hands down the best of them all. Everything we wanted or needed was close by and convenient. Cowgirl’s was closer than the beach and we visited there often; call ahead for carry out, your food will still be hot when you get back.
Thanks to Chip for the very helpful guide to all the features of the house and the many nearby restaurants and points of interest.
We are looking forward to a return next year.

reviews.author: Beth C.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Loved the location- easy walk or bike ride to so many great places. Chip, the owner was very accommodating and very easy to work with. The house was in great condition and well equiped with everything. We loved our view from the top balcony. The only thing that wasn’t ideal was the steps to the beach. The beach access is right across the street but there are a lot of steps. We looked at it as good exercise but it was tough for some folks in our family.
reviews.title: Beautiful, we’ll equiped home with a gorgeous view.

reviews.author: Mitzi M.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: The owner of this property goes above and beyond to ensure you have the very best experience. The property is immaculate. The 2 master suites are ideal for large combined families. We had fluffy white robes waiting for us! The gorgeous steam shower was a hit. All the sheets and towels are top quality. Well appointed and spotless clean upon our arrival. The kitchen had everything we needed and more. The owner was available for our every need or question. We wanted for nothing. We loved the surround area and the beach was a 2 minute walk door to sand. We had a wonderful beach bonfire night that will be one of my life long happiest memories. A short one mile walk to seaside was easy. Cowgirl kitchen was our breakfast go to spot being less than 5 minutes from our door. The supermarket was a 5 minute drive with a wine/spirits store in the same shopping center. All of this info was provided by the owner which made our stay so very enjoyable. Thank you to the Slagle's for making us feel like family.

reviews.author: Kim L.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: I can not speak highly enough about this house! Our family loves it so much, we have stayed here several summers in a row. It features two large master suites with every amenity you can imagine, including a steam shower. All other bedrooms have private baths. The entire house is professionally decorate. The kids love the bottom floor bunk room with the four beds suspended from the walls! It is perfect for multiple families or spread out with one large extended family. It is even equipped with an elevator, making the 3 levels easy for all ages and abilities. This house is truly equipped with everything you would ever need! Amazing views, with the primary living space, kitchen and one master bedroom on the 3rd floor! It is just steps from one of the most beautiful white sand beaches I have ever seen. If you are more of a pool person, your hot tub/pool oasis awaits you here, complete with heaters and lighting. You will never want to leave! Book My Wife's a Beach and enjoy!
